purpose: Source-traceable anatomical requirements for MSK visual fidelity. A requirement is not evidence that an asset depicts it or is clinically validated.

scope.scope_boundary: 22 source-menu investigations plus explicit supplementary/cross-specialty scope. The latter remains unresolved until separately expanded.

conventions.checklist_indices: Zero-based indices into the current effective reporting checklist. Labels and details are copied from repository-authored guides for traceability.
conventions.structure_ids: Stable region.structure identifiers; identical anatomy may recur with investigation-specific required parts and modality conditions.
conventions.required_parts: All listed parts are separate required targets. A parent structure label, bounding box or whole-bone mesh does not satisfy a missing part.
conventions.laterality: Instantiate side, digit and vertebral level where applicable. No implicit bilateral, paediatric, postoperative or pathology coverage.
conventions.condition: Conditional targets remain required for the relevant selected pathway; omission requires an explicit not-applicable reason, not missing assets.
conventions.site_instantiation: requires_site_instantiation=true records are unresolved templates. Expand to named patient-region/exemplar-specific members before calculating completeness.
conventions.source_basis: explicit_template_structure follows a named local template field; source_expansion adds an explicitly discussed source target; anatomical_decomposition_of_report_field is a reasoned decomposition requiring specialist review.
conventions.modality: modality_scope concerns direct image evidence. Schematic and 3D geometry are explanatory representations and do not replace MRI/ultrasound or establish patient findings.
conventions.review: Source reading is not clinical peer review, commercial licensing or asset-fidelity certification. These must be recorded separately for each image, schematic and model.
conventions.scope_issues: Incorrect or overbroad current checklist items are documented rather than silently converted into valid anatomy requirements.

reporting_checklist.label: Fractures and mortise
reporting_checklist.detail: Inspect the medial, lateral and posterior malleoli, distal tibia and talus; describe fibular level, fracture morphology/displacement and tibiotalar alignment.

reporting_checklist.label: Syndesmosis and proximal fibula

reporting_checklist.label: Osseous articular surfaces
reporting_checklist.detail: Describe visible talar-dome/plafond defects, impaction, articular step/gap and posterior-malleolar extent. Separate osseous findings from direct cartilage assessment on supplemental imaging.

reporting_checklist.label: Foot and hindfoot when included
reporting_checklist.detail: For the clinically indicated region actually imaged, assess hindfoot and tarsometatarsal alignment, navicular, cuneiforms/cuboid and metatarsals. State foot or hindfoot coverage not obtained.

expansion_rules.rule: Instantiate involved bones, joints, muscles, digit-specific tendons and sinus-tract/compartment routes. Include an amputation stump or altered postoperative anatomy when present. Generic bone or muscle groups cannot pass coverage.
Map each actual ulcer/tract separately through named tissues to specific bone, joint, sheath or collection; incomplete coverage remains explicit and unverified.

Use explicit14 MTP/IP site pairs. A named joint leaf does not itself instantiate opposing cartilage, synovium or bone-surface requirements. Distal hallux has one IP joint; do not create hallux middle phalanx/PIP/DIP.
Preserve hallux-versus-lesser anatomy and label normal reference material as a reference. A source slice showing one component cannot cover a whole plate, all attachments or a contralateral digit.

Separate tendon substance from its actual synovial sheath or other investing tissue. Do not propagate ankle synovial-sheath coverage to the entire distal extensor course; Achilles paratenon is not a universal tendon sheath. A generic tendon-group image does not instantiate every digit.

A compartment label cannot substitute for named contents; forefoot spread may cross compartments. Preserve imaged stump, resection margins, residual tendons and altered routes. Not every source model has every compartment or postoperative variant.

HALLUX_2021.supports: Nine cadaveric feet; figures2/3/5/7 identify the central portion, intersesamoid and paired sesamoid ligaments and supporting tendons. Authors explicitly differ from older descriptions of the central portion.

HALLUX_2002.supports: Hallux articular/periarticular anatomy, cartilage, sesamoid ligaments and named tendon attachments.

TENOSYNOVITIS_2017.supports: Evaluated named bone and tendon disease against surgery/histopathology; supports explicit tendon/sheath infection mapping, not universal clinical accuracy.

FDB_VARIATION_2005.supports: FDB fifth-toe anatomy varies; missing or small components must not be fabricated from a standard atlas.
